items.title: 68098_Snub Mosley oral history interview
items.q: I followed Charlie Barnett there. Then I played the Famous Door when they called it Club 52nd.

ctx.x: The closest you ever came to 52nd Street was that Barrell of Fun?
I played the Famous Door. I followed Charlie Barnett there. Then I played the Famous Door when they called it Club 52nd.
